locations.note: Laser-scanned venue of the Blancpain Endurance Cup's Monza round; the real 2019 race weekend also hosted the first SRO E-Sport GT Series round in this game.
Laser-scanned base-game circuit for the Blancpain Sprint Cup round held here in May 2018.
Hosts the 2018 Blancpain Endurance Cup round; an updated 2019 version came free with the game's 2019 season content.
Laser-scanned in early access build 0.3, down to the blue and red run-off stripes that grip better than the track; hosts the Endurance Cup round.
Laser-scanned base-game circuit for the Blancpain Sprint Cup weekend held here in June 2018.
Added in early access build 0.5 as the venue of the 2018 Blancpain season opener, a Sprint Cup weekend.
Laser-scanned base-game circuit for the September 2018 Blancpain Sprint Cup round.
The GP circuit hosts the 2018 Sprint Cup round; the Nordschleife only arrived years later, in the 24h Nürburgring Pack DLC, once licensing allowed.
Venue of the 2018 Blancpain season finale, an Endurance Cup race; an updated 2019 version came free with the 2019 season content.
Home of the 24 Hours of Spa, the championship's biggest race, which the game lets you run in full through a complete day-night cycle.
Added with the free 2019 season content when it joined the Blancpain calendar, and kept in its older layout rather than the reprofiled F1 version.
